{{Short description|Set theory}}
In set theory, the '''ground axiom''' states that the [[Universe (mathematics)|universe]] of set theory is not a nontrivial set-[[Forcing (mathematics)|forcing]] extension of an [[inner model]].  The axiom was introduced by {{harvtxt|Hamkins|2005}} and {{harvtxt|Reitz|2007}}.
